title: Anza coastal elevation model data
license: CC BY 4.0; see the root DATA_LICENSE.md file
authors: Amine Bouhadi; Lamiae Khali Issa; Ahmed Raissouni; Abdelkrim El Arrim

image.source_product: Sentinel-2 (author-reported; original product identifier and product metadata are not included)
image.acquisition_date: 2021-12-10 (author-reported from S2_20211210; not independently verified from the original product)
image.radiometry: Stored 0–255 RGB values; reflectance calibration unknown.

survey.vertical_units: Nominal metres, unconfirmed by primary survey report
survey.horizontal_projection: Lambert Zone 2/Clarke 1880; EPSG:26192 candidate consistent with plan

patches.coordinate_convention: Zero-based top-left row and column in the prepared EN array
patches.target: Signed centre elevation; includes positive land targets; not water depth
patches.channels: Linear interpolation of three RGB channels; not six measured spectral bands

common_random_status: Membership provided only; no reported training on this protocol
historical_warning: Earlier memberships overwritten; all recoverable test patches share training pixels
spatial_warning: One scene, seed and partition; no shared input pixels but no external validation
archive_omissions: January checkpoints and redundant historical maps are not included in this release
access_status: Public release; study data and derived data are provided under CC BY 4.0 as declared by the corresponding author
